# dpttrf

> Computes the L_D_L^T factorization of a real symmetric positive definite tridiagonal matrix A.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```js
import dpttrf from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/base/dpttrf';
```

### Layout API

Takes a storage layout (`order`) and leading dimensions, like CBLAS/LAPACKE.

```js
dpttrf( N, d, strideD, e, strideE ) → integer
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | The order of the matrix A.<br>Requires `N ≥ 0` |
| `d` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | **in/out** · On entry, the n diagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix A. On exit, the n diagonal elements of the diagonal matrix D from the L\*D\*L\*\*T factorization of A. |
| ↳ `strideD` | `integer` | Stride length for `d` |
| `e` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length N - 1</sub> | **in/out** · On entry, the (n-1) subdiagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix A. On exit, the (n-1) subdiagonal elements of the unit bidiagonal factor L from the L\*D\*L\*\*T factorization of A. |
| ↳ `strideE` | `integer` | Stride length for `e` |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `N`: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.
- `d`: On entry, the n diagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix A. On exit, the n diagonal elements of the diagonal matrix D from the $L \, D \, L^T$ factorization of A.
- `e`: On entry, the (n-1) subdiagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix A. On exit, the (n-1) subdiagonal elements of the unit bidiagonal factor L from the $L \, D \, L^T$ factorization of A. E can also be regarded as the superdiagonal of the unit bidiagonal factor U from the $U^T \, D \, U$ factorization of A.

</details>

**Returns** `integer`: info status code

**Throws**

- `RangeError` first argument must be a nonnegative integer

### Strided (ndarray) API

Takes explicit strides and offsets for every array. Use it for views, sub-matrices and non-unit strides.

```js
dpttrf.ndarray( N, d, strideD, offsetD, e, strideE, offsetE ) → integer
```

Computes the L_D_L^T factorization of a real symmetric positive definite tridiagonal matrix A.

## Notes

-   On entry, `d` contains the n diagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix A. On exit, the n diagonal elements of the diagonal matrix D from the L_D_L^T factorization of A.
-   On entry, `e` contains the (n-1) subdiagonal elements of A. On exit, the (n-1) subdiagonal elements of the unit bidiagonal factor L.
-   The routine uses a 4-unrolled loop matching the reference LAPACK implementation.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Order of the matrix<br>Requires `N ≥ 0` |
| `d` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | **in/out** · Diagonal elements (length N) |
| ↳ `strideD` | `integer` | Stride length for `d` |
| ↳ `offsetD` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `d` |
| `e` | `Float64Array`<br><sub>length N - 1</sub> | **in/out** · Subdiagonal elements (length N-1) |
| ↳ `strideE` | `integer` | Stride length for `e` |
| ↳ `offsetE` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for `e` |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `N`: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.
- `d`: On entry, the n diagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix A. On exit, the n diagonal elements of the diagonal matrix D from the $L \, D \, L^T$ factorization of A.
- `e`: On entry, the (n-1) subdiagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix A. On exit, the (n-1) subdiagonal elements of the unit bidiagonal factor L from the $L \, D \, L^T$ factorization of A. E can also be regarded as the superdiagonal of the unit bidiagonal factor U from the $U^T \, D \, U$ factorization of A.

</details>

**Returns** `integer`: status code

**Throws**

- `RangeError` first argument must be a nonnegative integer

### Status codes

An `info` status code: `0` on success. A positive value reports a numerical condition such as a singular pivot or a failure to converge (see the description). Invalid arguments throw instead of returning a negative `info`. Returns immediately when `N === 0`.

The reference documents `INFO` as:

-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -k`, the k-th argument had an illegal value
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = k`, the leading principal minor of order k is not positive; if $k < N$, the factorization could not be completed, while if $k = N$, the factorization was completed, but $D(N) \le 0$.

</section>

<section class="examples">

## Examples

```js
import discreteUniform from '@stdlib/random/array/discrete-uniform/lib/index.js';
import dpttrf from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/base/dpttrf';

/** @type {{ dtype: 'float64' }} */
const opts = {
	'dtype': 'float64'
};
const N = 3;
const d = discreteUniform( N, -10, 10, opts );
const e = discreteUniform( N, -10, 10, opts );

// Using the standard interface:
let out = dpttrf( N, d, 1, e, 1 );
console.log( out );

// Using the ndarray interface:
out = dpttrf.ndarray( N, d, 1, 0, e, 1, 0 );
console.log( out );
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->

<section class="reference-notes">

## Reference notes

The mathematical description from the reference LAPACK 3.12.0 source of `DPTTRF`. Indices are the 1-based Fortran indices of the source.

### Purpose

DPTTRF computes the $L \, D \, L^T$ factorization of a real symmetric positive definite tridiagonal matrix A. The factorization may also be regarded as having the form $A = U^T \, D \, U$.

</section>
